item.title: [LU-19778] sanity test_428: osd_write_commit() ASSERTION( PageLocked(lnb[i].lnb_page) ) failed
item.description:
This issue was created by maloo for Andreas Dilger <adilger@dilger.ca>

This issue relates to the following test suite run:
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/1bc63147-38dd-442a-b9b3-d38c637cc6e5

test_428 OSS crashed with the following error:

trevis-95vm3 crashed during sanity test_428

The OSS console showed:

Lustre: DEBUG MARKER: == sanity test 428: large block size IO should not hang == 07:41:54 (1768030914)
LustreError: 1848549:0:(osd_io.c:1506:osd_write_commit()) ASSERTION( PageLocked(lnb[i].lnb_page) ) failed: 
LustreError: 1848549:0:(osd_io.c:1506:osd_write_commit()) LBUG
CPU: 0 PID: 1848549 Comm: ll_ost_io00_047 5.14.0-570.62.1_lustre.el9.x86_64 #1
Hardware name: Red Hat KVM, BIOS 0.5.1 01/01/2011
Call Trace:
  <TASK>
  dump_stack_lvl+0x34/0x48
  lbug_with_loc.cold+0x5/0x43 [libcfs]
  osd_write_commit+0x53e/0x9f0 [osd_ldiskfs]
  ofd_commitrw_write+0x93f/0x1530 [ofd]
  ofd_commitrw+0x729/0xd60 [ofd]
  obd_commitrw+0x15f/0x2b0 [ptlrpc]
  tgt_brw_write+0xf4e/0x1aa0 [ptlrpc]
  tgt_handle_request0+0x14a/0x770 [ptlrpc]
  tgt_request_handle+0x3fd/0xd00 [ptlrpc]
  ptlrpc_server_handle_request.isra.0+0x2e8/0xd80 [ptlrpc]
  ptlrpc_main+0x9bf/0xea0 [ptlrpc]
  kthread+0xe0/0x100

Test session details:
clients: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-master/4694 - 5.14.0-570.62.1.el9_6.x86_64
servers: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-master/4694 - 5.14.0-570.62.1_lustre.el9.x86_64

This is not the same issue as the common LU-19774 OOM "CRASH" on aarch64+64k clients that has been hitting a lot recently. This session is both on x86_64 clients and the crash is on the OSS, but is the only CRASH failure not on aarch64 clients so it seems fairly uncommon.

Also, this is running rolling-downgrade-client2 with a 2.16.1.2 client2 vs. 2.17.50.28 client1+servers. While test_428 does not itself run on client2, it is possible there is some fallout from the previous test_413A failure in this session...
